edges: Palamon falls in love with Emily after seeing her in the courtyard.
Arcite also falls in love with Emily after seeing her.
Palamon prays to Venus to make Emily his wife.
Emily prays to Diana to marry the one who doesn't love her.
Arcite tells Emily to marry Palamon before he dies.
Palamon marries Emily after Arcite's death.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Theseus sentences Palamon and Arcite to gather 100 men each for a tournament.
Arcite prays to Mars for victory in the tournament.
Theseus captures Palamon and Arcite after defeating Creon in battle.
Theseus discusses the inevitability of death and the importance of dying with a good name.
